overview_description.description: GoodCourse is the mobile-first micro-learning platform, making e-learning accessible and engaging for non-desk workers and other remote audiences. By enrolling learners via text message and keeping learning content as brief as 3 minutes a day, GoodCourse removes all friction from the learning process - no apps, no logins, no struggling to find the time.
